title: Research 2026-10-20
body:
Studied: the engine's orders, bids and held-back reasons (live status), and the last digests. The last full analysis (2026-10-17) set the baseline of 1,411 settled bets; no new class-B change has met its evidence gates since, so no rule was loosened or tightened by the analysis routine.
Settings changed in the last two days (from the change log): bid slider 68 -> 80 (about 2.5% margin, more bid volume, every bid still +EV, money limits untouched); the engine's auto-bet now takes the slider's totals and team totals; a thin-fair guard (no bet or bid when the fair rests on 3 or fewer small companies with no sharp book); the experimental live rule trades small.
Right now: 359 bids resting (about $91). The auto-bet looked at 17 bets and placed none: all 17 were held back by the 6-hour trap guard (bets this early lost to the close). That guard stays: early spreads had CLV -2.15%.
Considering: raising bet volume inside the proven window (totals, team totals, NHL) and checking whether bid fills on game totals (-43% on 26) should drop out of the bid desk. Both wait for enough settled orders (200+) before any change.
Engine: the keeper is running and starts the engine at 08:00 ET with trading live and bids on.
